verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is an API product, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question, but the evidence pack contains none. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file, the markdown docs and the MCP server are related AI-facing features, not a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
